findings.reason: the plan should cite the producer module that will receive the publication path and the DDv4 floor, as it already cites `machine_maps/mast.json` for the map producer.
findings.text: §1 claims the producer replaces all three bespoke things "generically", but §4 states the dependency runs backwards (ambix imports and asserts on `nova.imas.machine_artifact`) and no producer-side publication/tag mechanism is cited, so the re-home of the 1,383-LOC live publication capability is designed against an interface never named or verified

findings.reason: the plan decides clean deletion partly because its inventory is complete; an enumerated-but-missing consumer must be added and rewired before the schema/digest fields leave the module.
findings.text: imports `nova.catalog.mast_geometry.shaped_section_vertices`, yet the §3 in-repo consumer inventory lists only `mast_flux_loop_adjudication.py`, `calibrate/sweep.py`, `catalog/__init__.py` and the seven `scripts/mast_*` files

findings.reason: re-homing the "machine-generic publication capability" without naming these owners forces the producer either to fork `DriveMap`/`EvidenceLedger` (a duplicate of a shared owner also used by `mast_geometry.py`, `mast_solve_inputs.py`, `mast_fitted_parameters.py`, `mast_seed_parameters.py`, `sourcemap.py`) or to import nova's copies, which is the reverse dependency §4 says it is trying to escape.
findings.text: `machine_artifact.py` imports `ChannelDrive, DriveMap` from `nova/imas/machine_drive.py:87` and `EvidenceLedger`/`MachineDescriptionError` from `nova/imas/machine_evidence.py:25,417`; §3's inventory names only `machine_artifact.py`

findings.reason: without naming the seam to extend, each rewired consumer is free to grow its own reader over the producer's map, which is exactly the parallel-surface duplication this plan exists to remove.
findings.text: the plan rewires twelve kLOC of consumers "to the producer route" but never names the existing geometry-consumption seam in `nova/imas/machine.py` (`MachineGeometryReader`, `TabularGeometryReader`, `StaticMachineDescription`) that must be the reader of the produced map

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design adds no module; it removes the in-repo registry and builder, so a shallow-wrapper layer is not introduced and the deep-module test does not arise.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 names only `machine_artifact.py`, omitting the shared owners it imports (`machine_drive.py`, `machine_evidence.py`) and never naming the existing nova geometry-reader seam that the consumer rewire must extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every §3 surface carries a delete/re-home disposition, so no section adds surface to these families without naming what leaves.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §1 asserts the ambix producer "replaces all three generically" while §2/§4 concede the producer carries no publication path today; the plan cites no producer-side publication mechanism it extends, and its consumer search omits `nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §3 removes a thin builder (`mast_solve_input_ids.py`) rather than adding one, and names why the publication script persists only until the producer carries the path.
